story: A fall told by email, a follow-up in the group chat: both kept for the same participant

messages.text: 1001-108 had a fall at home on 30 Aug and bruised her right hip. X-ray showed no fracture. PI informed.
messages.subject: 1001-108 fall

messages.text: 1001-108's hip is much better, she is walking without the cane again.
